headline: New same-major agent upgrade guide skips codemods, installs exact version
reason: The file is a bundled instruction set an agent follows to modify user repos, so its wording changes runtime agent behavior; the unsure call goes to the higher bucket.
risk_signals: drops codemod and config steps for same-major updates
summary: Adds a draft guide used for same-major Next.js updates. It tells the agent to install the exact target version, check it with `next --version`, verify the app, then return to shared.md for delivery. Unlike the old combined guide, it runs no codemod and has no step for setting experimental.agenticAutoUpgrade, so that now depends on the prompt text.
focus: Same-major runs no longer get the codemod or the explicit agenticAutoUpgrade step; confirm the prompt text alone covers the setting
Guide asks to 'Update other dependencies if needed' with no limit, so the agent may change more than the Next.js version
The `shared.md` and `future-defaults.md` names must match the files next-upgrade.ts copies from the built docs
